Hold No. 21 pick in the June 23 draft; eyeing shooting and ball-handling. Jalen Duren a key restricted free agent.
Super Bowl LX champs received rings June 11; minicamp wrapped. Rookie RB Jadarian Price competing for snaps.
Landed 4-star edge Chaz Gray over Tennessee and Clemson; 2026 kickoff times set, season opens late August.
Rebuilt roster: one returning starter plus transfers and international signings Tisma, Devers and Braga.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL RESHAPES 2026-27 ROSTERS AS DRAFT WITHDRAWALS LAND
headlines.detail: Iowa State's Milan Momcilovic (16.9 ppg, 48.7% from three) committed to Kentucky and Wake Forest's Juke Harris (21.4 ppg) chose Tennessee, while 38 players withdrew from the NBA Draft to return to school.

headlines.headline: 2026 NBA DRAFT OPENS JUNE 23 WITH WIZARDS HOLDING NO. 1 PICK
headlines.detail: Washington won the lottery and is on the clock first, with Duke's Cameron Boozer and UNC's Caleb Wilson in the mix. The champion Knicks (beat the Spurs 4-1) and Pistons, at No. 21, round out a deep first round.

headlines.headline: SUPER BOWL LX CHAMPION SEAHAWKS WRAP OFFSEASON PROGRAM
headlines.detail: Seattle received its Super Bowl LX rings on June 11 and closed mandatory minicamp under coach Mike Macdonald's 'run it forward' message. Rookie RB Jadarian Price is competing for early snaps alongside George Holani.

headlines.headline: RECRUITING HEATS UP: WESLEY TO TEXAS, O'NEAL FLIPS TO FLORIDA STATE
headlines.detail: Five-star edge Richard Wesley (No. 11 in the ESPN 300) committed to Texas on June 22, while four-star QB Jaden O'Neal flipped from Oklahoma to Florida State. Florida, Texas and Texas A&M led June's recruiting risers.
